meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 装上后,会把你给的访谈/播客视频,按你选的 16:9、9:16 或 4:5 画布,加上与说话内容同步的图文卡片——动态标题、下三分之一、数据标注等;原视频画面不动,最终输出 MP4。卡片内容和节奏由视频实际内容决定。
howto.when: 当用户要求给现成的访谈/播客视频加图形覆盖层,或提到“graphic overlays”“on-screen graphics”“package / dress up my video”等时触发;纯字幕或不确定走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这段采访视频加“下三分之一”和引用卡片,用 9:16 竖版。
say.note: 会先生成故事板,再渲染成 MP4。

say.text: 把这段播客视频包装成带数据标注和画中画的版本,原片不动。
say.note: 原视频画面保持,图形层按时间轴叠加。

say.text: 按这个视频的逐字稿设计动态标题和侧栏,最少 5 张卡片。
say.note: 卡片数量和节奏由时长与信息密度推断。

howto.what_en: Adds transcript-synced graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts) to an existing talking-head/podcast video on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas; original clip untouched; outputs MP4. Card content and pacing follow the transcript.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests for graphic overlays, on-screen graphics, or packaging/dressing up an existing video. Not plain subtitles; when unclear, route to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add lower-thirds and quote cards to this interview video, 9:16 portrait.
say_en.note: It drafts a storyboard, then renders MP4.

say_en.text: Package this podcast video with data callouts and PiP; original clip untouched.
say_en.note: Original video stays as-is; graphics layered on the timeline.

say_en.text: Design kinetic titles and side panels from the transcript; at least 5 cards.
say_en.note: Card count/pacing inferred from duration and density.
